summary: P1-29 broad/silent exception-handler inventory for foms/ + root runtime. Every broad catch (except Exception/BaseException/bare) is classified LOG_AND_CONTINUE / SWALLOW_BY_CONTROL_FLOW / FAIL_CLOSED / INTENTIONAL. UNCLASSIFIED (silent `pass`, no logging, no marker) must be 0; SWALLOW_BY_CONTROL_FLOW (continues with no logger wired) is pinned at a no-growth baseline (AUDIT-LOG T11).
scope: foms/**.py + root runtime (app.py, db.py, models.py, run.py, wdcalculator_db.py, wdcalculator_models.py)
overlap_api_error_01: API-ERROR-01 owns response/stdout exposure (print_exc/str(e) -> log_handled_exception). This packet owns swallow classification. Sites that log via log_handled_exception are LOG_AND_CONTINUE here.
marker_convention: Silent-by-design catches carry an inline `# failopen: intentional: <reason>` (or `fail-closed`) marker; the scanner reads it as the justification. No bare allowlist, no lint-disable.
